title: Mapping Industry Practices to the EU AI Act’s GPAI Code of Practice Safety and Security Measures
measurement_description: Not applicable. The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on mapping AI industry safety and security practices to the EU AI Act's code of practice, primarily concerning risks like CBRN, cybersecurity, and loss of control.
models_tested: Models from OpenAI (e.g., GPT-4, GPT-4.5, o1, o3, o4-mini)
Models from Anthropic (e.g., Claude 3.7, Claude Opus 4, Claude Sonnet 4)
findings: None. The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The word 'religion' is mentioned once in a quote from an external document (Anthropic's Constitution for Claude) as part of a general non-discrimination clause, but it is not a subject of analysis in the paper.
